name: Morton-coded Sparse Voxel Tree
definition: A flat-array sparse voxel tree that uses Morton codes for spatial ordering and an 8-bit mask per node to track children. It avoids recursive pointers by storing nodes in contiguous blocks of 8 elements, indexed via `node_format::_block_index`.
summary: A Morton-coded Sparse Voxel Tree is a flat-array sparse voxel tree using Morton codes and 8-bit masks to retain a hierarchical structure, unlike sibling methods that flatten the tree for memory efficiency.
